_doc: 第 6 幕每格背景描述，Claude 看地圖手寫，2026-11-13

EP1-06-01.zh: 鏡頭貼近地面，對著森林空地中間的一小片泥地。泥地在畫面正中間，是薄薄一層濕泥，四周是鋪著落葉和矮草的森林地面。泥地後面，畫面左邊是一顆長滿青苔的大石頭，畫面右邊是一片高高的蕨類。泥地正上方的空中，一圈藍色的時光隧道光正在縮小、快要消失。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。
EP1-06-01.en: Background: The camera is down near the ground, facing a small patch of mud in the middle of a forest clearing. The mud patch is in the middle of the picture, just a thin layer of wet mud, surrounded by forest floor with leaf litter and low plants. Beyond the mud, on the left side of the picture, is a big moss-covered boulder, and on the right side is a patch of tall ferns. In the air right above the mud patch, a ring of blue time-tunnel light is shrinking and about to vanish. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right.

EP1-06-02.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，對著空地中間一小片薄薄的泥地和空地的另一頭。泥地後面是鋪著落葉和矮草的地面；畫面左邊是一顆長滿青苔的大石頭，畫面右邊是一片高高的蕨類。再過去，空地往前延伸一段，左右兩邊和盡頭都被又高又密的森林圍住，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。盡頭那排樹偏右的地方有一道窄窄的缺口，透出一點亮光。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來，空氣看起來又熱又濕。
EP1-06-02.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, facing a small, thin patch of mud in the middle of the clearing and the far end of the clearing. Beyond the mud is ground covered in leaf litter and low plants; on the left side of the picture is a big moss-covered boulder, and on the right side is a patch of tall ferns. Farther on, the clearing stretches a little way and is closed in on the left, on the right and at the far end by tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. In the row of trees at the far end, a little right of center, there is one narrow gap with a faint glow of light showing through. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right; the air looks hot and humid.
EP1-06-02.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。

EP1-06-03.zh: 手機和握著它的手指填滿整個畫面，螢幕四周看不到其他景物。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照在螢幕上。
EP1-06-03.en: Background: The phone and the fingers holding it fill the whole picture; nothing else shows around the screen. Morning sunlight falls on the screen from behind the camera on the right.

EP1-06-04.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，對著空地的另一頭。畫面中間和右邊是一片高到腰的蕨類。畫面左邊緣露出一點長滿青苔的大石頭。蕨類過去，空地往前延伸一段，左右兩邊和盡頭都被又高又密的森林圍住，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹；盡頭那排樹偏右的地方有一道窄窄的缺口，透出一點亮光。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。
EP1-06-04.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, facing the far end of the clearing. Across the middle and right side of the picture is a patch of waist-high ferns. At the left edge of the picture, a bit of a big moss-covered boulder shows. Beyond the ferns, the clearing stretches a little way and is closed in on the left, on the right and at the far end by tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers; in the row of trees at the far end, a little right of center, there is one narrow gap with a faint glow of light showing through. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right.
EP1-06-04.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。

EP1-06-05.zh: 鏡頭斜斜地對著一片高到腰的蕨類和空地的另一頭。蕨類往後再長一小段，蕨類過去是開闊的空地，往前延伸一段。畫面左邊和盡頭都是又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，把空地圍住。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。
EP1-06-05.en: Background: The camera looks at an angle toward a patch of waist-high ferns and the far end of the clearing. The ferns continue a short way back, and beyond them the open clearing stretches a little way. On the left side of the picture and at the far end is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, closing the clearing in. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right.
EP1-06-05.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。

EP1-06-06.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，對著空地邊上靠近森林的那一角。畫面左邊，緊挨著空地的是又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。畫面右邊是一片高到腰的蕨類。畫面中間偏右，空地往前延伸一段，盡頭也是一整排又高又密的樹，靠右邊有一道窄窄的缺口，透出一點亮光。地面鋪著落葉和矮草。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。
EP1-06-06.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, facing a corner of the clearing close to the forest edge. On the left side of the picture, right up against the clearing, is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. On the right side of the picture is a patch of waist-high ferns. Just right of the middle of the picture, the clearing stretches a little way and ends at another solid row of tall, dense trees, with one narrow gap toward the right where a faint glow of light shows through. The ground is covered in leaf litter and low plants. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right.
EP1-06-06.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。

EP1-06-06W.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，往後退得比較遠，對著空地邊上靠近森林的那一角。畫面左邊是又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，樹頂高到超出畫面上緣。畫面右邊是一片高到腰的蕨類，蕨類過去是空地另一邊的森林。畫面中間，空地往前延伸一段，盡頭被一整排又高又密的樹擋住，靠右邊有一道窄窄的缺口，透出一點亮光。整片空地四周都被森林圍住。地面鋪著落葉和矮草。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來，空氣看起來又熱又濕。
EP1-06-06W.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, pulled well back, facing a corner of the clearing close to the forest edge. On the left side of the picture is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, the treetops rising past the top edge of the picture. On the right side of the picture is a patch of waist-high ferns, and beyond the ferns is the forest on the other side of the clearing. In the middle of the picture, the clearing stretches a little way and is blocked at the far end by a solid row of tall, dense trees, with one narrow gap toward the right where a faint glow of light shows through. The whole clearing is closed in by forest on every side. The ground is covered in leaf litter and low plants. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right; the air looks hot and humid.
EP1-06-06W.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。

EP1-06-07.zh: 畫面被眼睛和四周長青苔的皮填滿，看不到其他景物。上午的陽光從鏡頭左後方照過來，照在青苔上。
EP1-06-07.en: Background: The eye and the mossy hide around it fill the whole picture; nothing else shows. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the left and falls on the moss.

EP1-06-08.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，正對著空地靠近森林的那一邊。畫面左邊，緊挨著空地的是又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。畫面右邊是一片高到腰的蕨類。畫面中間，空地往前延伸一段，盡頭是一整排又高又密的樹，偏右的地方有一道窄窄的缺口，透出一點亮光。地面鋪著落葉和矮草。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。
EP1-06-08.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, facing straight toward the side of the clearing near the forest. On the left side of the picture, right up against the clearing, is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. On the right side of the picture is a patch of waist-high ferns. In the middle of the picture, the clearing stretches a little way and ends at a solid row of tall, dense trees, with one narrow gap right of center where a faint glow of light shows through. The ground is covered in leaf litter and low plants. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right.
EP1-06-08.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。

EP1-06-08W.zh: 鏡頭從稍高的地方，正對著森林空地靠近森林的那一邊，看得比較遠。畫面左邊，緊挨著空地的是又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。畫面右邊是一片高到腰的蕨類，蕨類過去是空地另一邊的森林。畫面中間，空地往前延伸一段，盡頭被一整排又高又密的樹擋住，偏右的地方有一道窄窄的缺口，透出一點亮光。整片空地四周都被森林圍住。地面鋪著落葉和矮草。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。
EP1-06-08W.en: Background: From a slightly raised position, the camera faces straight toward the side of the forest clearing near the forest, seeing a long way. On the left side of the picture, right up against the clearing, is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. On the right side of the picture is a patch of waist-high ferns, and beyond the ferns is the forest on the other side of the clearing. In the middle of the picture, the clearing stretches a little way and is blocked at the far end by a solid row of tall, dense trees, with one narrow gap right of center where a faint glow of light shows through. The whole clearing is closed in by forest on every side. The ground is covered in leaf litter and low plants. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right.
EP1-06-08W.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。

EP1-06-09.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，斜斜地對著空地邊上的森林。畫面下方是一小片薄薄的泥地。泥地過去，畫面正中間略偏右是一顆長滿青苔的大石頭，石頭後面緊挨著又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，橫過整個畫面。畫面右邊，森林前面是開闊的空地。地面鋪著落葉和矮草。上午的陽光從鏡頭左後方照過來。
EP1-06-09.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, looking at an angle toward the forest at the edge of the clearing. At the bottom of the picture is a small, thin patch of mud. Beyond the mud, in the middle of the picture and slightly to the right, is a big moss-covered boulder, and right behind the boulder is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, running across the whole picture. On the right side of the picture, in front of the forest, is open clearing. The ground is covered in leaf litter and low plants. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the left.
EP1-06-09.conflict: prompt 寫甲龍在 HERO「後方偏左」；照地圖（相機 J30、HERO H29、甲龍 D27–F28），甲龍幾乎就在 HERO 正後方、略偏右。背景照地圖寫。

EP1-06-09W.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，往後退得比較遠，斜斜地對著空地邊上的森林。畫面下方是一小片薄薄的泥地。泥地過去，畫面正中間是一顆長滿青苔的大石頭，石頭後面緊挨著又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，橫過整個畫面。畫面右邊，森林前面是一大片開闊的空地。地面鋪著落葉和矮草。上午的陽光從鏡頭左後方照過來。
EP1-06-09W.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, pulled farther back, looking at an angle toward the forest at the edge of the clearing. At the bottom of the picture is a small, thin patch of mud. Beyond the mud, in the middle of the picture, is a big moss-covered boulder, and right behind the boulder is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, running across the whole picture. On the right side of the picture, in front of the forest, is a wide stretch of open clearing. The ground is covered in leaf litter and low plants. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the left.
EP1-06-09W.conflict: prompt 寫甲龍在 HERO「後方偏左」；照地圖（相機 J31、HERO H29、甲龍 D27–F28），甲龍在 HERO 正後方、畫面中間。背景照地圖寫。

EP1-06-10.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，對著空地的另一頭。畫面裡大半是一片高到腰的蕨類，從左邊一直長到右邊。畫面右邊，蕨類旁邊就是又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹。蕨類過去，空地往前延伸一段，盡頭被一整排又高又密的樹擋住；那排樹在畫面中間附近有一道窄窄的缺口，透出一點亮光。上午的陽光從鏡頭右後方照過來。
EP1-06-10.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, facing the far end of the clearing. Most of the picture is a patch of waist-high ferns spreading from the left side to the right side. On the right side of the picture, right next to the ferns, is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers. Beyond the ferns, the clearing stretches a little way and is blocked at the far end by a solid row of tall, dense trees; near the middle of the picture that row has one narrow gap where a faint glow of light shows through. Morning sunlight comes from behind the camera on the right.
EP1-06-10.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。

EP1-06-11.zh: 鏡頭站在森林空地上，斜斜地對著一片高到腰的蕨類。蕨類過去是開闊的空地，再過去是又高又密的森林，有蘇鐵、銀杏和針葉樹，把空地圍住。上午的陽光在鏡頭正後方。
EP1-06-11.en: Background: The camera stands in a forest clearing, looking at an angle toward a patch of waist-high ferns. Beyond the ferns is open clearing, and beyond that is tall, dense forest of cycads, ginkgos and conifers, closing the clearing in. The morning sun is directly behind the camera.
EP1-06-11.conflict: 2026-11-13 地圖加樹林擋住河，重寫背景。
